matchupOfTheWeek.title: Pass Defense vs. Pass Offense
matchupOfTheWeek.description: Our pass defense grades 90/100 (among the NFL's best) against LV's pass offense at 68/100 (above average) — the widest statistical edge on the board this week.

previewTake: We're hosting a Raiders team that's as lopsided as they come: their defense is genuinely elite (4th in EPA/play), but their rushing attack is almost comically bad (3/100 grade), and their pass offense is merely above average. The good news? We have the week's widest statistical advantage right on the board—our pass defense (90/100) against their pass offense (68/100)—which should give Drake Maye some breathing room after he just earned AFC Offensive Player of the Week honors for three touchdowns against Buffalo. The bad news is our pass protection (35/100) meets their pass rush (90/100), their elite defense should feast on our below-average passing attack (29/100), and we've lost three straight to these guys. But we're favored by 3.5 at home, we're riding momentum off a comeback win, and if we can lean on our solid rushing game while Maye keeps the Raiders honest through the air, we should have a real shot at finally breaking that hex.
